description: Flat sample-level metadata schema for ITS amplicon sequencing of fungal communities from forest soil samples across forest types and time points.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample record. Example: FS_TROP_001_2024-06-15.

site_id.descr: Stable identifier for the sampling site/location.

site_name.descr: Human-readable site name or locality description.

forest_type.descr: Forest category or biome. Controlled values should be used where possible, e.g. temperate, tropical, boreal, subtropical.

habitat_description.descr: Additional description of the sampling habitat, e.g. primary forest, secondary forest, plantation, mixed woodland.

sampling_date.descr: Date the soil sample was collected, in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

sampling_timepoint.descr: Temporal label for repeated sampling within the study, e.g. T1, spring_2024, wet_season.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees, WGS84. Negative values indicate southern hemisphere.

longitude.descr: Longitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees, WGS84. Negative values indicate western hemisphere.

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the sampling site above sea level, in meters.

country.descr: Country where the sampling site is located.

region_or_province.descr: Administrative region, province, state, or similar subnational location.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval of soil collection in centimeters, e.g. 0-10 cm.

soil_layer.descr: Soil horizon or layer sampled, if known, e.g. litter layer, topsoil, mineral soil.

soil_pH.descr: Soil pH measured from the sampled material; report method separately if needed.

soil_moisture_pct.descr: Soil moisture content as percentage of fresh weight or gravimetric water content, depending on study protocol.

organic_matter_pct.descr: Organic matter content of the soil sample, percent (%).

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at sampling time, in degrees Celsius, if measured.

soil_texture.descr: General soil texture class, if available, e.g. sandy, loamy, clayey.

canopy_cover_pct.descr: Estimated canopy cover above the sampling point, in percent (%), if available.

vegetation_description.descr: Dominant vegetation or plant community associated with the site.

land_use.descr: Land use or disturbance context, e.g. protected forest, managed forest, agricultural edge, undisturbed.

sample_replication.descr: Replicate label or replicate number for the sample within the site and time point.

depth_replicate_id.descr: Identifier for within-site/depth replicate if multiple cores or subsamples were collected.

dna_extraction_id.descr: Identifier linking the sample to the DNA extraction record.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing technology used, e.g. Illumina MiSeq, NextSeq, NovaSeq.

library_prep_protocol.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for ITS amplicon sequencing.

its_region.descr: ITS target region sequenced, e.g. ITS1, ITS2, full-length ITS.

primer_forward.descr: Forward primer sequence or primer name used for amplification.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse primer sequence or primer name used for amplification.

pcr_cycles.descr: Number of PCR cycles used during amplification.

amplicon_size_bp.descr: Expected or observed amplicon length in base pairs (bp).

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs (bp) for the sequencing run, if applicable.

run_id.descr: Sequencing run or flow cell identifier.

host_association.descr: Whether the sample is free-living soil, rhizosphere, or associated with plant roots/roots nearby.

sampled_by.descr: Name or identifier of the person or team that collected the sample.

collection_method.descr: Brief description of the soil sampling method, e.g. soil corer, auger, composite sample.

preservation_method.descr: How the sample was preserved prior to DNA extraction, e.g. frozen at -20 C, silica-dried.

storage_temperature_c.descr: Storage temperature before extraction, in degrees Celsius, if known.

notes.descr: Any additional free-text notes relevant to interpretation of the sample.
